description:
ClearSalary is a simple salary ledger for very small businesses — the kind with 2 to 10 staff, run by an owner who's tired of tracking who's owed what across WhatsApp messages, a notebook, or memory.

ClearSalary answers one question clearly: how much do I owe each staff member today? It is not payroll software — there's no tax filing, no statutory compliance, no payslip law to navigate. Just salary, loans, deductions, and payment history, kept simple.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Staff Ledger — a running record of every entry for each staff member, with a live balance.

• Loan Book — give a staff member a loan, record repayments, and always see what's still outstanding. Kept separate from salary deductions, so the two never get confused.

• Salary Deductions — record a deduction against a month's salary in a tap.

• Salary Slips — ClearSalary works out what's due each month automatically. Mark a slip Paid when you pay, and optionally recover a loan instalment from it.

• Attendance & Leave — mark leaves and see them reflected on the salary slip.

• Staff Overview — see your whole team at a glance, with a clear "Paid" or "Due" status for each person.

• Available in English and Hindi.

HOW IT WORKS

Sign up with your name, business name, and phone number — no password, just a one-time code sent by SMS. Add your staff, record salaries, loans, and payments as they happen, and ClearSalary keeps the running total for you. Staff can also log in with their own phone number to see their own salary and loan history — read-only, and only their own.

WHO IT'S FOR

Restaurant, café, salon, shop, garage, and workshop owners — any small business owner who currently tracks staff salary and loans by hand and wants something simpler, without switching to full payroll software they don't need.

PRICING

ClearSalary is free to use while we're building it out. There is nothing to buy inside the app.

Questions or feedback? Write to us at support@clearsalary.in.

description:
FOF Rider — the official driver app for Foods on First delivery partners.

This app is exclusively for active delivery riders working with Foods on First. Sign in with the rider account provided to you by the operations team to receive, manage, and complete deliveries.

If you are a customer looking to order food, please use the Foods on First customer app or website at foodsonfirst.com — this app will not work without an authorized rider account.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH FOF RIDER

— Receive new delivery requests in real time

— View pickup and drop-off locations on an integrated map

— Get turn-by-turn navigation to restaurants and customers

— Update delivery status (picked up, en route, delivered)

— Track your shift earnings and completed deliveries

— View your delivery history and performance summary

HOW IT WORKS

1. Foods on First creates your rider account and shares your login credentials.

2. Sign in to the app and complete your rider profile.

3. Go online when you are ready to start a shift.

4. Accept incoming delivery requests assigned to you.

5. Follow the in-app navigation to pick up the order and deliver it to the customer.

6. Mark the delivery as complete and continue to the next one.

PERMISSIONS WE REQUEST AND WHY

— Location (precise, including background): Required to receive delivery assignments based on your location, navigate to pickup and drop-off points, and keep customers informed of delivery progress while the app is running in the background during an active shift.

— Notifications: Required to alert you of new delivery requests, customer messages, and shift updates.

— Phone: Used to call customers or restaurant contacts directly from the app when coordination is needed.

We only collect data while you are on an active shift, and stop collecting location data when you go offline. Full details are available in our Privacy Policy.

REQUIREMENTS

— An authorized FOF Rider account issued by Foods on First operations.

— An Android device with GPS and a stable internet connection.

— Permission to use precise location, including background access during shifts.

SUPPORT

If you experience issues with the app, contact the Foods on First rider support team:

Email: support@foodsonfirst.com

Phone: +1 (215) 568 3555

For privacy-related questions, please review our Privacy Policy linked on this listing.

Foods on First — 1429 Arch St, Philadelphia, PA 19102

Inox is the all-in-one block management platform built specifically for UK managing agents and block management companies. Manage your entire residential leasehold portfolio from your phone — approve invoices, track issues, communicate with leaseholders, and stay on top of your finances wherever you are.

Block management is demanding, fast-moving work. Property managers spend much of their week away from a desk — on site visits, inspections, and contractor meetings. The Inox mobile app gives you the full power of the platform in your pocket, so nothing waits until you're back in the office.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED, ON THE GO

With the Inox app, your whole team works from one connected platform — property managers, accountants, leaseholders, and contractors — replacing spreadsheets, legacy software, and endless email chains with streamlined, intelligent workflows.

KEY FEATURES

- AI invoice processing — Upload invoices and let AI read, categorise, and prepare them for approval automatically. No more manual data entry.

- One-click approvals — Approve invoices in a single tap, with the supplier, block, and budget position all shown together. Approve from a car park, a site visit, or anywhere else.

- Automated bank reconciliation — Service charge accounts stay accurate in real time, with no manual month-end exercise.

- Open banking payments — Make payments directly from the platform using your existing bank accounts.

- Ticket & issue management — Leaseholder reports become tracked tickets instantly. Assign, update, and resolve issues with the full history logged automatically.

- In-app messaging — Communicate with leaseholders and contractors in the context of specific issues. Nothing gets lost in email.

- Real-time financial visibility — Check balances, arrears, and budget positions across your whole portfolio, instantly, from your phone.

- Leaseholder portal — Give residents and RTM directors self-service access to issue reporting, financial information, and documents, reducing inbound queries.

BUILT FOR UK BLOCK MANAGEMENT

- Inox is not a generic property tool adapted for block management. Every feature is designed around the specific workflows, terminology, and regulatory requirements of the UK residential leasehold sector — from service charge accounting to leaseholder communication and compliance.

WHO INOX IS FOR

- Block management companies

-Managing agents

- Property managers

- Block management accountants and finance teams

- RTM directors and resident management companies

Whether you manage ten blocks or several hundred, Inox scales with your portfolio.

THE RESULTS MANAGING AGENTS SEE

- Significant reductions in accountant time

- Faster invoice processing and financial close

- Fewer missed maintenance incidents

- Lower email volumes

- Improved leaseholder transparency and satisfaction

WHY MANAGING AGENTS CHOOSE INOX

Traditional block management software was built for desktops and a different era. Inox was built mobile-first, AI-powered, and purpose-designed for how block management teams actually work today. The result is less admin, smarter accounting, faster responses, and a genuinely better experience for everyone in the building.

WORK SMARTER, WHEREVER YOU ARE

Download the Inox app to manage your blocks, approve invoices, track issues, and stay connected with your team and leaseholders — all from your phone.

The Inox app works alongside the full Inox web platform, keeping your data synced and up to date across desktop and mobile in real time.

To find out more, request a demo, or learn how Inox can transform your block management business, visit www.inoxliving.io.

description:
Use Insurance Auto Auctions’ (IAA) app to bid on lightly damaged cars and other salvaged vehicles anytime day or night, including cars, trucks, SUVs, motorcycles, and heavy equipment. We cater to anyone who wants to buy lightly damaged or salvaged cars: used car dealerships buying hundreds of lightly damaged vehicles, mechanics and body shops looking for car parts, and people who buy cars for scrap.

A portion of our inventory comes from vehicle fleets (rental car agencies, company cars, etc.) or bank repossessions with little or no damage. We also serve buyers seeking wrecked car auctions, featuring vehicles with heavy to light amounts of damage, including totaled cars.

You can search our inventory without an account, but you’ll be able to bid and have access to additional features when you log into your IAA account. Register for a free account on our used car auction app, or visit our site at www.iaai.com to sign up. Search by make and model, then browse and filter our extensive inventory of cars up for auction. Use IAA 360 View to get complete details of the interior and exterior of every vehicle, then see and hear the engine running with our IAA Interact™ Merchandising Platform . IAA Interact combines imagery, information and personalization to deliver detailed vehicle information with unmatched research tools, improved purchasing guidance and greater transparency.

Features:

• My Account: Manage offers you’ve made, see your watch list, manage payments and review the vehicles you’ve purchased.

• Vehicle Search: Search our extensive Insurance Auto Auction inventory and use filters to select criteria that matter to you when searching for your salvage car, wrecked car or whole car.

• Make, Model & More: Fine tune your search with vehicle filters for make and model, year, new inventory, vehicle type and subtype, odometer, start code, series, fuel type, cylinders, transmission, drive line type, airbags, primary damage, loss type, keys, body style, country of origin, exterior color and interior color.

• Vehicle Data: Auto auction listings include vehicle details such as vehicle identification number (VIN), Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) specifications and part interchange numbers.

• See It Up Close: IAA 360 View and IAA High Resolution Images show the salvaged vehicle in 360 degrees.

• Does It Run? See & hear IAA Engine Starts video clips of the salvaged car’s engine so you know which vehicles are in running condition. We also categorize auction cars online as either Run and Drive, Starts or Stationary, as well as providing IAA Key Images so you know if keys are available.

• Live Auctions: Browse through auto auction sales lists, and bid with our salvage car sale mobile app. Find an auction by IAA branch, city or state, or search by date to see upcoming salvage auto auctions.

• Other Auction Types: Select your auto auction type: Timed Auctions, Buy Now, Dream Rides, Rec Rides, Specialty and Virtual Lane

• Locations: Access branch locations and contact information including directions from Apple or Google maps

• Pay by App: View and pay for the vehicles you win, including the option to pay with PayPal, or floor plan financing for qualifying buyers.
whats_new: Introducing Premium Guest Membership: Gain access to premium research tools for greater insights, including Engine Starts™, 360 View™, and Live Auctions. Experience these features as a Premium Guest, or upgrade to a Registered Buyer to start bidding on IAA vehicles.

Handle multiple restaurant outlets or branches from one dashboard, across multiple phones or devices.

description:
The SchedulePlus application was created on the basis of the Schedule4 application. SchedulerPlus has new functions and has a changed design to meet new standards and has improved widget quality. Works on devices with Android 4.2 and above. Schedule4 users can transfer all data by saving a copy of the settings and then loading it into the SchedulePlus program.

The SchedulePlus program is used to display the work schedule in a two-shift, three-shift, four-shift or five-shift system for any selected month and year.

The program has the following defined systems:

✔ four-gear:

★ 1111 W 2222 W 3333 WW

★ 3333 WW 2222 W 1111 W

★ 3333 W 2222 W 1111 WW

★ 11 22 33 WW

★ 1,122,333 WW 1,122,233 WW 1,112,233 WWW

★ 1111 W 3333 W 2222 WW

★ 111111 WW 222222 WW 333 333 WW

✔ five-gear:

★ 112233 WWWW

✔ any system:

★ three-gang

★ four-gear,

★ five-stroke.

- you define yourself any cyclical three-run, four-run or five-run schedule.

- it is determined whether it is a two-shift, three-shift or four-shift system.

- the number of working hours per shift is defined (6, 8 or 12, necessary for the correct display of the work norm).

- it is determined whether holidays are days off (mainly applies to three-brigade systems).

- you can also choose the option of Saturdays and Sundays always free.

In the program settings, define the type of work system and the starting days of the cycle for individual brigades (the first day of the first shift for A, B, C, D, and E brigades (for a five-brigade)). Based on these data, the program calculates the work schedule.

You can set the "My brigade" field, then the selected brigade column in the schedule will be highlighted.

You can add additional days off to the schedule (DW - holiday, CH - sick, and any other types, they are defined in the window Holidays - menu - Edit types of days off).

In addition to days off, you can add additional working days to the schedule.

You can add notes to individual days of the month. To view or add a note, hold your finger over the appropriate day field on the main screen. The days to which the note was added have a yellow background.

Notes can also be managed from a dedicated window.

Monthly and yearly statistics are available.

The change names, the default "1", "2" and "3", can be changed. You can also change the names of the brigades, by default "A", "B", "C", "D", "E".

The work schedule can be made available in the form of JPG graphics. Such graphics can be saved to a file or sent by MMS, e-mail, etc.

The application has the ability to create profiles and switch between them. In each profile you can save a different graphic and all settings related to it.

The program has two widgets displaying the graphics. When adding a widget to the screen, select the profile from which the schedule is to be displayed and whether the profile name should be visible in the widget.

In the program, for each shift, you can set an audible alarm for any hour. For example, on each day when the 1st shift falls, we set the morning wake up call. If an additional day off (e.g. vacation) is inserted in the schedule, the alarm does not ring.

For the alarms to ring at the set time, turn off battery optimization for the app.

I encourage you to recommend the application to colleagues.

If you want a special version of the application dedicated only to your company, write to me by e-mail.

description:
Gemini Locator — lone worker safety and emergency alerting, wherever work takes you.

Gemini Locator protects people who work or travel alone, or who simply feel vulnerable on the job — across every sector, in any country. When something goes wrong, Locator makes sure help is on its way fast, using real-time location to guide the response without compromising personal privacy.

Key features:

SOS Alarm — one tap, or one press of a paired Bluetooth button, instantly raises a panic alarm and can automatically call a pre-set emergency contact.

Pre-Alarm / Man Down Monitoring — set a check-in timer before a risky task or visit. If you don't check in on time, the app automatically escalates to a Man Down alert with more frequent location updates.

Shift Location Monitoring — track and report your position throughout a shift, so your organization always knows you're safe.

Bluetooth SOS Button Support — pair a compact wearable button for hands-free panic alerting, even with the phone in a pocket or bag.

Emergency alerts by SMS — If there is no data or Wi-Fi, SOS and Man Down alarms are sent by SMS instead, so an emergency alert still reaches the Alarm Receiving Centre in poor coverage or underground.

Privacy by design — location is used only for safety and emergency response, is encrypted in transit, never sold, and never shared for advertising or marketing.

Gemini Locator is part of the GeminiSense platform by Bold Communications, connecting your lone workers directly to a monitored Alarm Receiving Centre for real, human response when it matters most.

Ilovaning asosiy imkoniyatlari:

Real vaqt rejimida kuzatuv (Tracking): Yukingiz hozir qayerda? Kargo raqamingizni kiriting va yukingizning har bir harakatini (omborga kelishi, jo‘natilishi va yetib kelishi) xaritada kuzating.

Shaxsiy kabinet: Har bir mijoz uchun alohida profil. Bu yerda siz barcha buyurtmalaringiz tarixini ko‘rishingiz va shaxsiy ma’lumotlaringizni boshqarishingiz mumkin.

Bildirishnomalar (Push Notifications): Yukingiz holati o‘zgarganda (masalan, kargo omborga yetib kelganda yoki bojxonadan o‘tganda) darhol xabar olasiz.

UTS ID tizimi: Har bir foydalanuvchi uchun maxsus UTS ID beriladi, bu esa yuklarni rasmiylashtirish jarayonini osonlashtiradi va xavfsizlikni ta’minlaydi.

Ko‘p tilli interfeys: Ilovadan o‘zbek, rus va ingliz tillarida bemalol foydalaning.

Zamonaviy dizayn: Glassmorphism uslubidagi minimalist va ko‘zga yoqimli interfeys orqali ilovadan foydalanish yanada zavqli.

Nima uchun UTS Cargo’ni tanlashadi?

Shaffoflik: Yukingiz qayerda ekanligi haqida doim aniq ma'lumotga ega bo'lasiz.

Xavfsizlik: Ma’lumotlaringiz va yuklaringiz xavfsizligi bizning ustuvor vazifamizdir.

Tezkorlik: Ilova optimallashtirilganligi sababli barcha ma’lumotlar soniyalar ichida yangilanadi.

UTS Cargo — yuklaringiz ishonchli qo‘llarda!

Ilovani yuklab oling va xalqaro logistika qulayligini his qiling.

Write CNC programs in minutes. CNC Pocket Programmer is a complete offline G‑code toolkit in your pocket. Generate ready‑to‑run milling programs, visualize toolpaths in 3D, calculate spindle speed and feed rate, and send code directly to your CNC machine from your phone or tablet.

No internet required. No expensive CAM licenses. Select the operation, enter dimensions, and get production‑ready G‑code instantly.

WHO IS IT FOR?

CNC learners just getting started with G‑code, operators who need a quick program on the shop floor, hobbyists with desktop mills, or small businesses that can't afford costly CAM software this app is for you. It covers the vast majority of everyday milling operations. Use it as your primary tool or as a fast companion alongside your existing workflow.

G‑CODE GENERATORS

• Rectangular and circular pocket milling

• Contour milling (inner/outer, climb/conv,)

• Face milling, slot milling (straight and arc)

• Thread milling (helical interpolation)

• Peck drilling, tapping, simple drilling, circular hole patterns

• DXF/SVG import engraving, profile and pocket modes

• STL import — waterline, parallel and 3‑axis surface machining

• Parametric sketch editor draw and machine your own shapes

• Text engraving (Hershey single‑line fonts)

3D Relief model from JPG/PNG/BMP/WebP Image

All generators support multi‑pass depth, finishing with G41/G42 cutter compensation, climb and conventional milling, and safe Z height.

7 POST‑PROCESSORS

Fanuc, Haas, Okuma, Mitsubishi, Siemens, GRBL, Mach3.

3D TOOLPATH PREVIEW

Animated visualization with rotation, zoom, pan, Z‑depth color scale, line‑by‑line playback, and tool marker. See exactly what your machine will do before pressing Cycle Start.

SKETCH EDITOR

Draw shapes on screen rectangles, circles, slots, holes, arcs, text. Set machining mode per element (pocket, profile, engrave) and generate G‑code for the entire drawing in one step. A simple CAD/CAM right on your phone.

SPEED & FEED + CALCULATORS

170+ material presets enter tool and material, get spindle speed, feed rate, and plunge instantly. Also: machining power and time, chip thinning, ball‑nose cusp height, drill tip calculation, bolt circles, triangle solver, unit conversion, thread tables, material weight, ISO Tolerances

SEND CODE TO YOUR MACHINE

• RS‑232 USB serial

• Bluetooth

• WiFi TCP socket and FTP upload

• Auto‑detection: identifies your controller (Fanuc, Haas, Siemens, etc.) and recommends optimal settings

8 built‑in profiles plus custom profiles for any machine.

EVERYTHING IN ONE APP

G/M‑code reference, drill tables, thread tables, material database, PDF and DXF export, QR sharing, saved programs no switching between apps.

METRIC AND IMPERIAL

Full mm/inch support across generators, calculators, and post‑processors.

4 LANGUAGES: English, Hungarian, German, Spanish.

Try it free for 15 days then unlock everything with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.No hidden fees.

FREE / PRO / ULTRA

• FREE: Basic generators, RS‑232 transfer, calculators, reference tables

• PRO: All generators and transfer modes, advanced calculators, unlimited export, Sketch editor, Ad-free

• ULTRA: PRO + DXF/SVG import, STL 3‑axis machining,

BUILT FOR THE SHOP

Dark theme, tablet support, 100% offline.

PRACTICAL TOOL, NOT A CAM REPLACEMENT

This is a mobile app, not desktop CAM software. It has its limits. But for small shops, hobbyists, and most everyday machining tasks it gives you everything you need. The generated G‑code is a solid starting point that speeds up your work and can be customized for your setup.

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ

CNC machining involves real tools, materials, and risks. The user is fully responsible for verifying and safely running any G‑code generated by this app. Always review the program, do a dry run, and confirm all parameters for your machine before cutting. The developer assumes no liability for damage or injury from use of this application. By using CNC Pocket Programmer you agree to these terms.

description:
The Federation of the Swiss Watch Industry FH is delighted to publish a new version of the Dictionary of Horology for everyone with an interest in watchmaking, as well as the general public. It follows on from the Illustrated Professional Dictionary of Horology, written by G.-A. Berner and published by the Swiss Chamber of Watchmaking in 1961, the supplement published by the Société du Journal La Suisse Horlogère SA in 1995 and the consolidated version by the FH in 2002, which many experts still refer to as the “Berner Dictionary”.

The dictionary has been completely revised to reflect the changes in the world in general, and the watchmaking industry in particular. Accordingly, a panel of experts has reviewed 4,800 terms and 950 illustrations to decide whether they should be retained, amended or removed, alongside the addition of 470 new entries. The experts involved have taken care only to retain and add terms related directly to watchmaking, to make the dictionary a unique work that is entirely dedicated to the sector. The latter often uses specialist terms that are known only to insiders, which is why it is important to make them accessible to anyone with an interest in the subject.

Written in French, German and English, the new version contains 6,000 terms and almost 900 illustrations, some of which have been deliberately kept in their original style.

© Federation of the Swiss Watch Industry FH 1961-2024 - www.fhs.swiss

Whether you are just starting your astrology practice or are an experienced practitioner, AstroCall Astrologer helps you modernize your approach and reach more clients with convenience and confidence.

Who Can Use AstroCall Astrologer?

* Professional Astrologers

* Tarot Readers

Join the future of astrology consulting.
